title: Vice President/Senior Vice President, Infrastructure and Energy Debt Advisory
description:
Join Macquarie Capital’s Infrastructure and Energy Debt Advisory team in New York, where you will lead complex financing transactions and advise clients across the energy and digital infrastructure sectors. In this senior, client-facing role, you will shape financing strategies, develop key sponsor and lender relationships, and play an important role in the continued growth of the team’s advisory platform.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

### **What role will you play?**

In this role, you will lead financing transactions across energy and digital infrastructure, including power and renewables, energy transition, conventional energy and midstream, utilities, data centers, fiber, towers, and communications infrastructure. You will manage transactions from initial client engagement and financing strategy through lender outreach, due diligence, negotiation, documentation, and closing. You will assess credit profiles, financial models, and downside scenarios to develop capital structures that align with client goals and market conditions. You will also identify new opportunities, strengthen senior client and lender relationships, and partner with colleagues across Macquarie Capital to deliver integrated financing solutions. You will guide and develop junior team members while maintaining high standards of execution, collaboration, and risk management.
